source.book: Numerology With Tantra, Ayurveda, and Astrology: A Key to Human Behavior
source.author: Harish Johari

introduction: Rules people born on day 5, 14, or 23, or whose destiny/name number totals 5.
Mercury, the smallest planet in the solar system, is famous for quick response, changeable character, ready wit, and restlessness — an "evergreen" planet that is always young.
Sanskrit name Kumar ("youthful") reflects its youthful, princely nature; also called Buddha, the planet of buddhi — intellect and ready wit (pratiuttapanna mati).
Related to the respiratory system, the nervous system, speech, education, and intelligence.

Neutral in gender; regarded as cold and moist. Ruled by Earth as its element; merchant-like by nature, taking risks and gambling — a planet of extremes: natives may be lovers of physical comfort and money-minded, or entirely unconcerned with money and comfort.

A benefic, auspicious planet that nonetheless makes natives suspicious, serious, cunning, sometimes deceitful; also witty, humor-loving, manipulative, wise, delicate, attractive, fond of travel and adventure; born orators with a scientific approach; lovers of fine arts, soft-spoken, doubting, fragile, tenderhearted.

Drawn to astrology, numerology, palmistry, physiognomy, graphology, and psychology out of a desire to understand themselves and others; materialistic, rational, analytical, critical, and fond of modern ideas.
Has a dual, mixed-temperament nature — natives weigh pros and cons simultaneously; learned, scholarly, and drawn to like-minded company. The only planet exalted in its own sign (Virgo).
Friendly with the Sun, Venus, Rahu, and Ketu; neutral with Saturn, Mars, and Jupiter; feels enmity toward the Moon, though the feeling is not mutual.

psychicNumber: Gentle, fragile characters and elevated thinkers; natural scholars whose active brains are constantly engaged in thought.
Love amusement, work to create a happy, jovial atmosphere around them — sometimes exhausting their own energy and resources trying to make everyone happy.

Quick decision-makers, impulsive; love change, avoid long-range plans (which require patience), though always scheming new ways to make money; speculative and risk-willing, sometimes gambling — which can bring wealth.

Youthful, fertile, mature-minded — unique and attractive; make friends easily and quickly with any number, but being unstable by nature, friendships don't last; often break friendships easily during weak periods, feeling deceived and lonely.
Highly intuitive — accurately read visitors' intent and colleagues'/partners' maneuvers; often answer a question before the asker finishes, saying "I know what you mean."
Very adaptable, bear tragedy and calamity with a smile — yet inflexible at home, disliking anyone touching or rearranging their things.
Relate to children like a child, to young people as a revolutionary/progressive youth, and to the wise elderly with wisdom of their own.
Brilliant logicians whose openness and eloquence disarm opponents; can befriend opponents and convert them to their own viewpoint.
Impress others through an attractive, charming personality, progressive ideas, adaptability, clarity of expression and logic, positive/optimistic attitude, and jovial youthfulness.
Spendthrifts, sometimes extravagant, though able to save for hard times despite fluctuating finances; generally lucky in getting money when needed.

Never earn through one source alone — can't sit idle, love inventing quick money-making methods, always investing in business; speculative and risk-taking, ultimately successful and reliable as business partners.
Time-conscious, value their own time, always in a hurry.
Fond of fine arts, especially poetry, expressing ideas poetically.
Flexible character, change easily — but distinctively resist changing their actual way of working.
Natural travelers, broadening knowledge through journeys at home and abroad; enjoy living in foreign lands away from family.

Born on the 23rd: luckier than those born on the 5th, helped by relatives, superiors, government officials, politicians, and authority figures. Born on the 5th: face more family obstacles/opposition but achieve material success quickly; obstinate, hardworking, independent, reliable, self-made, lucky in love; peaceful, comfortable, youthful, well-supported old age.

Believe in fate and destiny yet praise the law of karma and work constantly, knowing fate matters more; lucky enough to get what they want by chance; if they gamble, often multiply their money two or three times and don't regret losses; live on their nerves and love excitement.
Not swayed by preaching — appreciate tradition without becoming mystical; remain independent thinkers open to new ideas; enjoy the company of both the learned/wise and the young/progressive.
Very cautious about health, careful food selection, conscious of physical appearance; though fragile, have strong builds and remain healthy, active, and usually long-lived into old age.
Because Mercury is exalted in its own sign (Virgo), two psychic number 5s make the best of friends.

Psychic-5 women are more attractive, impressive, gentle, soft-spoken, and fragile than psychic-5 men; career-conscious, building magnificent careers through hard work and pleasing manners; can benefit from marrying young, since finding true friends/mates gets harder later in life. They attract people easily but, being cunning, overly selective, and diplomatically superficial with the opposite sex, find it hard to choose a good husband — only a few men qualify. Business or social association with men brings them financial and social gains; they execute duties so perfectly they earn recognition and stay beyond criticism.
precautions: These precautions are especially helpful during weak periods.
Never lose their natural sense of humor and jovial nature.
Avoid bitter, pungent, or sharp language when angry.
Stop being overly critical on all occasions.
Avoid stress and strain on the heart and nerves.
Keep the company of children and don't stay away from amusement.
Stop hurrying all the time.
Stop straining the eyes with night reading or excess TV/films/performances.
Avoid misjudging people — build faith in friends and well-wishers instead.
Overcome irritation and brooding.
Do exercises to build self-confidence, tranquility of mind, calmness, and heart-strength.
Develop more patience toward family members and friends.
Avoid being fatalistic; try to become less obstinate.
Avoid excess salt if troubled by heart or blood-pressure problems (more salt is fine, even advisable, during childhood/adolescent growth periods if untroubled by heart or skin ailments).
Avoid exposure to cold.
Avoid forcing their ideas on others.
Avoid giving false hope or making false promises to others.
Avoid trusting strangers and being inattentive while traveling.
Take good, long morning walks.
Drink more juices and stay conscious of blood purity — easily susceptible to skin diseases and heart trouble.
Take small trips, stay happy, avoid the company of unsuccessful or pessimistic people.
Listen patiently to others' opinions.
Massage the body with almond oil once or twice weekly to strengthen nerves and enhance circulation.
Do manual labor or gardening to relieve an overactive brain.
Favor business or life partnerships with numbers 5, 1, 3, or 9.
Develop contacts with prominent people without selfish motive.
Learn to be content, honor friends, and appreciate others.
destinyNumber: Five is the best destiny number for psychic number 5 people — makes them very strong, obstinate, independent (but dependable), lucky, wise, attractive, and impressive.

Psychic number 6 also suits destiny number 5 people well — they become self-sufficient early in life, solve their own problems, run good businesses, and create an inspiring atmosphere for colleagues/partners; 6's slow decision-making balanced with 5's quickness makes their choices valuable.

Five is a good destiny number because it brings gentleness, kindness, wisdom, intuition, insight, happiness, alertness, and good luck; wealth through lottery, inheritance, and business risk; logical, rational, systematic natures; the power to speculate and progress materially, sometimes becoming pioneers, discoverers, or inventors; favors from government, authority figures, political leaders, friends, and relatives; recognition for contributions; versatility, attractiveness, and natural optimism; change in work and living situations; good luck in love; and long periods living in foreign lands.
Five is a good destiny number for all psychic numbers except 2 and 7.
Best suited professions: publishers, writers, lawyers, critics, politicians, businessmen, actors, scholars, orators, storytellers, entertainers, sculptors, and astrologers.
nameNumber: Also a good name number — makes natives progressive, jovial, and lively; brings popularity and positive vibrations.
Especially beneficial when the destiny number is also 5 — brings great material success, fame, and a name remembered even after death.

Not good for those with a psychic or destiny number of 2 or 7, or a destiny number of 4 — makes 2s more unstable, gives 7s a bad name, and creates growing difficulties for 4s, since 5 is a number of communication and 4 dislikes communicating.
Very favorable for writers, poets, businessmen, bankers, sportsmen, publishers, journalists, doctors, actors, politicians, and those in the communications business.
weakPeriods: Number 5 people often feel weak and sad because Mercury is frequently retrograde.

Can bring weakness, lack of interest, sickness, lack of joy/humor/inspiration, health setbacks, oversensitivity, overworry, or financial loss and debt — especially during May, September, and December.
During these months they can feel deceived by friends and partners, and become lonely, withdrawn, suspicious, doubting, and obstinate.
strongPeriods: Good for undertaking new jobs, making new contracts or promises, finishing jobs, and seeking better housing or work.
sections.goodDates: Days 5, 14, and 23 of any month are good, especially when falling within a strong period.
sections.goodDays: Wednesday and Friday; even more beneficial when falling on day 5, 14, or 23 of the month.
sections.favorableColors: All shades of green, turquoise, light brown, smoky grey, and white — use in clothing, pillows, cushions, curtains, tablecloths, bedsheets. Keep a green, grey, or white handkerchief; washing hands, face, and eyes and drying with it brings refreshment and energy when uneasy.
preciousStones: An emerald of three carats (or its substitute), set in an open-back ring, worn on the little finger.
Bought and given to the jeweler on a Wednesday; picked up and worn (after proper rituals) on a Wednesday.
Emerald powder taken to help the body heal electrochemically.
sections.meditation: Meditate on Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, peace, and prosperity; if not possible, meditate on an emerald or its substitute gemstone.
sections.deity: Mahalakshmi — four-armed, seated in the lotus posture on a pink lotus in blue water; one right hand blesses, the other holds a pot of holy elixir water; one left hand holds a lotus flower, the other pours out gold coins, giving wealth.

mantra.text: AUM MAHALAKSHMAYE VIDMAHE VISHNU PRIYAYE DHI MAHI — TANNO LAKSHMI PRACHODAYAT
mantra.repetitions: Recite as many times as possible during meditation; brings material and spiritual benefits and strengthens willpower.

yantra.description: Yantra of Mercury — 3x3 numerical magic square (kamea)

healthAndDiseases: Mercury-linked ailments: chronic dysentery, constipation, gastric pain, gastritis, indigestion from weak stomach fire, kidney problems, restlessness of mind, and fear of evil spirits/ghosts.
Also susceptible to flu, colds and coughs, skin problems, nervous breakdowns, headaches, weak memory, blood pressure problems, and heart ailments.
sections.fasting: Fast on full moon days; if born on a Wednesday, also fast on Wednesdays.
sections.friendship: Their best friend is another number 5; numbers 1, 3, and 9 are also suitable for friendship.
romance: For marriage and romance, choose partners born May 21 - June 21 or August 21 - September 20.
Best psychic numbers for a mate: 1, 3, 5, or 9; psychic number 1 natives are very suitable.
sections.goodYearsInLife: The 5th, 14th, 23rd, 32nd, 41st, 50th, 59th, 68th, 77th, and 86th years are best; years totaling to 1 (1st, 10th, 19th, 28th, 37th, 46th, 55th, 64th, 73rd, 82nd, 91st) are also very favorable.

relationships.1: Friendly numbers. Ones bring good luck, expensive gifts, and social status to 5s, though 5s are never really influenced by 1s in return; 5s are always helpful, good friends to 1s in need. Fives help 1s gain social status and financial gain through their speculative skill and systematic methods. Both being independent, a 1-man doesn't make a great husband for a 5-woman, though a 1-woman can be a good wife to a 5-man. In business, 1s aren't good partners for 5s, but 5s make good partners for any number, including 1s. Both work well together in politics and social fields, and should rely on each other.
relationships.2: A strange relationship. Though 2 is neutral toward 5, 5s feel no rapport with 2s; both being unstable numbers, they create problems for each other, only enjoying each other's company over silly, foolish tasks — 2s become very funny and suggest foolish ideas to 5s. Twos should not select a 5 for appointment dates, residential numbers, bank accounts, telephones, or license plates. Fives are attracted to 2s at first, but friction soon develops and the relationship ends — 5s should avoid business or marriage with 2s.
relationships.3: Jupiter (3) is neutral to Mercury (5), and 3s have a positive influence on 5s — together they create humor and joy, helping and enjoying each other's company. Number 3 men can be good life partners for number 5 women. In business, 5s always gain financially from 3s, who in turn learn the secrets of accounting and good business from 5s.
relationships.4: Though 5s are friends of 4s, they don't become ideal friends — 5's unstable nature creates problems for 4. Unsuitable for friendship, marriage, or business partnership, unless the 4 has 5 as a destiny number.
relationships.5: Two number 5s become powerful together — unlike most same-number pairings (usually fruitless), this combination reaches unexpected heights in politics, art, and business. People with 5 as both psychic and destiny number are impressive, attractive, wise, and cunning, with strong personalities regardless of gender. Fives are good for each other in every respect — friendship, business partnership, or marriage — and should also select 5 for appointment dates or residential numbers.
relationships.6: Mutual friends. Sixes are slow, 5s are quick; 6s rein in 5s' speedy minds and help them overcome restlessness. Sixes are beneficial for 5s in friendship, business partnership, and marriage; 5s serve as good therapists or physicians to 6s. Five should select the number 6 for appointment dates and residential numbers.
relationships.7: Friendly but not lastingly so — 5s and 7s are easily attracted to each other, and 5s inspire 7s in many ways, though always in the wrong direction; together they can slip into mischievous or malicious thinking without being of any practical help to each other. Sevens don't provide positive energy to 5s, so they're not good for friendship, business partnership, or marriage; as life partners, 5s always find fault in 7s and blame them for family problems.
relationships.8: Saturn (8) is neutral to Mercury in friendship, but 5s feel friendly toward 8s, with few difficulties as friends — though 8s tend to neglect 5s, making 5s reluctant to cooperate wholeheartedly. Fives should avoid 8s for friendship, business partnership, or any important venture, especially marriage. Unless the psychic-5 person has 8 as a destiny number, they should not select 8s for appointment dates or residential numbers.
relationships.9: Mars (9) is an enemy of Mercury (5) astrologically, but since Mercury (like Saturn) is neutral toward Mars in friendship, 9s actually help 5s in business, money, and livelihood matters, creating good vibrations together — fiery, hot Mars-ruled 9 and cold, moist Mercury-ruled 5 form a working pair of opposites, with number 9 acting as a patient spouse and guardian. Fives should select 9s for friendship, projects of mutual interest, and business partnership. In the absence of a good number-5 husband, number-5 women should choose a 1 or 3 first, with 9 as the last choice — though marriage with a 9 is possible and can be long-lasting if the couple is spiritually inclined. Fives should also select 9 for appointment dates and residential numbers.
